AssignmentCountsOut.description:
One set of assignments counted at both granularities the platform actually uses.

``cases`` counts distinct ``(case, reviewer)`` pairs -- the *selection* granularity, because
allocation is case-native: the planner assigns whole cases, and a reviewer never gets the same
case twice (see ``AllocationServiceBase._case_key``).

``review_units`` counts ``(review unit, reviewer)`` pairs -- the *durable* granularity, one
row per ``AssignmentPlan``/``Assignment``. Publishing fans each planned ``(case, reviewer)``
out over every in-scope field/relation of that case, so ``review_units`` is normally the much
larger number.

Both are reported together, always, because the admin screen previously mixed them without
saying which was which: the pre-publish panel showed the case count and the publish result
showed the unit count, so the same campaign read as 8 in one place and 40 in another.
AssignmentCountsOut.title: AssignmentCountsOut

CampaignAllocationSummaryResponse.description:
Simple campaign allocation math: ``total_assignments = selected_cases *
reviews_per_case`` (number of reviews per case), ``estimated_assignments_per_reviewer =
ceil(total_assignments / selected_reviewers)``. ``assignment_plan`` is a read-only, seeded
preview of a balanced case/reviewer plan -- publishing assignments still goes through the
existing allocation-run preview/persist/publish endpoints.
CampaignAllocationSummaryResponse.title: CampaignAllocationSummaryResponse

CampaignCaseProgressItem.title: CampaignCaseProgressItem

CampaignDeleteResponse.description:
A "delete" is a status transition to ``closed`` -- the ``campaigns`` table rejects hard
``DELETE`` at the database level ("close or supersede instead"), so draft removal is
represented the same way a completed campaign's closure is.

Deleting a draft returns its review units to the shared eligible-case pool (the inverse of
``materialize_from_pool``), so the freed cases become selectable by a future campaign;
``cases_returned_to_pool``/``units_returned_to_pool`` report how much was released.
CampaignDeleteResponse.title: CampaignDeleteResponse

CampaignEditRequest.description:
Edit campaign policy and save a case selection for future additions.

``campaign_key`` is never editable (immutable at the database level). Changing the source or
case selector requires ``confirm=true``; ``closed`` campaigns cannot be edited. ``case_filter``
and ``case_id_selection`` are mutually exclusive and a non-empty selection requires its
matching source-bound Apply receipt. The selection remains active until changed or cleared.
CampaignEditRequest.title: CampaignEditRequest

synthesize_missing_values.description: Opt-in (default off). When true, a case missing a selected field group gets an explicit 'missing' review unit synthesized instead of being excluded from eligibility. Default-off keeps existing campaign flows byte-for-byte unaffected; the flag is persisted on the campaign so later top-ups (load_pool_cases) reuse the same decision.
synthesize_missing_values.title: Synthesize Missing Values

CreateCampaignRequest.title: CreateCampaignRequest

GroundedIn.description:
The document an evidence window was taken from, named so a reviewer can tell it apart.

Additive: resolved from the review subject's own persisted member/relation observations, so it
never reaches for a document outside this unit's family. Deliberately carries no internal case
identifier -- reviewer blindness forbids them in reviewer payloads; the document hash, its
source system and (for citation fields) the member's citation identify the document.
GroundedIn.title: GroundedIn

MemberSourceValue.description:
One family member observation's value for this field, source-labelled.

Served whenever the canonical family holds more than one source observation; the reviewer
adjudicates between the sources instead of one being silently preferred. ``value`` is a
bounded PREVIEW (``value_truncated`` marks the cut); the full value and complete evidence stay
on the review subject's attributes, which the same bundle serves.
MemberSourceValue.title: MemberSourceValue

ReviewerAssessmentInput.description: Assessment of one opaque, pseudonymous reviewer submission.
ReviewerAssessmentInput.title: ReviewerAssessmentInput

ReviewerCampaignSummary.description:
Per-campaign reviewer queue summary: identity, own-work counts, and selected fields.

Counts are scoped to the calling reviewer only (no peer-reviewer leakage): ``not_started``
is the open pool still claimable by this reviewer, ``in_progress`` is this reviewer's own
claimed-but-unsubmitted assignments, and ``completed`` is this reviewer's own submitted
assignments in the campaign.
ReviewerCampaignSummary.title: ReviewerCampaignSummary

ReviewerCaseQueueItem.description:
One distinct case the reviewer holds at least one assignment for in this campaign.

Aggregates every review unit/field the reviewer owns for the case (grouped by
``snapshot_local_case_external_id``, the same real case identity used by the admin
per-case table and the grouped bundle) -- never one row per field.
``anchor_assignment_id`` opens the case's grouped workspace (``GET
.../grouped-bundle``), which itself re-derives the full field set from any one of
the case's assignments.
ReviewerCaseQueueItem.title: ReviewerCaseQueueItem

case_count.description: Optional cap on imported review units, applied after review_scope filtering in fixture order. None imports every in-scope unit. reviewer_count.description: Reviewers are always 0 at import time and assigned manually afterwards via the roster/allocation endpoints; automatic reviewer assignment at import is not implemented.

reviews_per_case.description: Number of reviews per case before a unit is submitted/resolved. Defaults to 2. Only takes effect the first time a campaign key is created; a later import into an existing campaign uses that campaign's already-persisted value (see editCampaign to change it beforehand).
reviews_per_case.title: Reviews Per Case
